review_scope: Current first-party published terms for every domain in tools/shopify_candidates.txt; product endpoints were not probed.
legal_note: Operational research gate, not legal advice. Absence of an explicit prohibition is not treated as permission for bulk dataset collection and retention.

contract_requirement.approval_rule: A store must have a documented basis permitting automated product-metadata collection and research retention before its products.json endpoint is touched.

gate.reason: No candidate has published permission evidence; the locked selector requires at least eight approved stores.

resolution_paths: Obtain and record written permission for at least eight stores, then re-run this audit and only afterward probe products.json.
If licensed or open data must replace merchant endpoints, write a new pre-collection contract version and disclose the protocol change; do not silently weaken the locked v1 contract.
